# Vinayak Rajendra Gund — Engineering Portfolio
> AI/ML Engineer, Software Developer, Data Analyst, and Big Data Engineer based in Pune, India.

## Summary
Vinayak Rajendra Gund is an AI/ML Engineer and Software Developer specializing in production-ready machine learning pipelines, LLM-powered automation agents, scalable backend architectures (Node.js, TypeScript, FastAPI), and distributed big data workflows (Apache Spark, Hadoop, Kafka).

## Key Projects
- **AutoPrint**: WhatsApp-based self-service printing platform featuring an 8-state stateful text conversation engine, Cashfree transaction gateways, and SumatraPDF automation managed via Redis and BullMQ async workers. (Tech: Node.js, TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ, Docker). GitHub: https://github.com/gundvinu1/autoprint
- **AI Automation Agent**: Natural-language automation assistant for Gmail, Calendar, reporting, and productivity workflows using LangChain LLM orchestration layer logic and Google API integrations. (Tech: Python, FastAPI, LangChain, LLMs, PostgreSQL). GitHub: https://github.com/gundvinu1/AI-Automation-Agent-
- **Credit Card Fraud Detection**: Machine learning system for detecting fraudulent transactions using classification models, feature engineering (reducing false positives by 18%), and structured evaluation (87% accuracy). (Tech: Python, Scikit-Learn, Pandas, NumPy). GitHub: https://github.com/gundvinu1/Credit-Card-Fraud-Detection-
- **Text to 3D Model Generation**: Deep learning NLP-to-3D representation pipeline concept converting natural language descriptions into 3D models using TensorFlow.
